family: At n=0 return 0. Otherwise choose the least prime k with k^5 >= n^3 and return 0 if k >= n. The first k input bits are the low coefficients of a monic binary polynomial Q of degree k. In F2[Z]/(Q) encode the other n-k bits in r=ceil((n-k)/k) successive blocks X_i, padding on the right by zeros, with low coefficients first throughout. For i=1,...,r set b_i=r+1-i. Return the constant coefficient of the degree-less-than-k representative of the elementary symmetric polynomial of order ceil(sqrt(r)) in the r elements X_i^(2^b_i-1).
theorem: For this one total uniformly polynomial-time family, in NP with empty witnesses, every sufficiently large integer n satisfies C_B2(f_n) >= 4n - (77/5)n^(4/5) for exact, single-output circuits over all sixteen binary truth tables at actual input length n. In particular the all-length liminf of C_B2(f_n)/n is at least 4.
